overview_description.description:
Vitau is a subscription model pharmacy for patients with chronic diseases. Every month, they deliver all the medicines that a patient with chronic diseases needs, and support them with all the procedures of their insurance company. It makes users subscribe to select products or medicines and order them online using a payment method that is accessible via the internet

Vitau's mission is to improve people's health and lives through simple technology and excellent customer service. It was founded in 2019 and is headquartered in Mexico.

product.name: Subscription Model Pharmacy Service
product.description: A pharmacy service offering medication delivery on a subscription basis for patients with chronic diseases across Mexico.

product.name: Medication Delivery Service
product.description: A service that delivers medications to patients throughout Mexico, including local and national shipping options with tracking.

product.name: Medication Ordering and Management Platform
product.description: An online platform that allows users to order medications, schedule recurring orders, and set reminders for medication refills.
